function.name: GET_JOY_POSITION
function.param: Number of axis (0 for the axis X, 1 for the axis Y)
function.abstract: It returns the position of an axis of the joystick

description.p: It returns the position (If it is centered 0, in oppositive case, it returns a number among -255 and 255) of an axis of the joystick selected by .
